title.narrative: Advancing ethical frontier technologies for sustainable development

description.narrative: The UNESCO Liaison Office in New York will strengthen the visibility and recognition of UNESCO's work at the intersection of AI and other emerging and converging technologies. By amplifying the Organization's voice on the complex ethical and human rights challenges these technologies pose, the Office will reinforce UNESCO's role as a global intellectual and policy leader. It will further support UNESCO's engagement at the United Nations system level, contributing to inter-agency coordination and policy coherence on AI, including system-wide efforts on governance, capacity-building, and the implementation of global AI governance frameworks.
